description: SAP One Domain Model entity type taxonomy for the benchmark landscape. 40 canonical business objects serving as the cross-system semantic anchors. All retrieval resources in the landscape must reference at least one entity type from this package. The relatedEntityTypes links form a connected graph enabling Method C (Graph Walk) to traverse the full landscape from any entry point.

packages.title: ODM Entities
packages.shortDescription: Canonical business object taxonomy for the benchmark landscape
packages.description: 40 entity types covering HR, Procurement, Finance, Sales, CX, Manufacturing, PLM, EHS, and ITSM domains. Every retrieval resource must reference at least one entity type to participate in graph-based retrieval.

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing employee entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing workforce person entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing expense report entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing cost center entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Account

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing account entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Customer Order
entityTypes.shortDescription: A sales order placed by a customer for goods or services.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing customer order entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Customer Account
entityTypes.shortDescription: A record representing a customer including contact and financial data.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing customer account entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Customer

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing customer entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Customer Journey

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing customer journey entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Customer Segment
entityTypes.shortDescription: A grouping of customers with shared characteristics for targeted marketing.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing customer segment entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Campaign

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing campaign entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Sales Opportunity

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing sales opportunity entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Machine

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing machine entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Production Order

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing production order entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Maintenance Order

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing maintenance order entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: IoT Sensor Stream

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing iot sensor stream entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing material entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Quality Inspection

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing quality inspection entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Product Item

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing product item entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Engineering Change

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing engineering change entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Safety Incident
entityTypes.shortDescription: A workplace event involving injury, near-miss, or hazardous condition.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing safety incident entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Incident

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing incident entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Substance
entityTypes.shortDescription: A chemical or material subject to regulatory handling requirements.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing substance entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Hazardous Substance

entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing hazardous substance entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Service Ticket
entityTypes.shortDescription: A request or incident record in an IT service management system.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing service ticket entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: IT Equipment
entityTypes.shortDescription: Hardware assets such as laptops, phones, and servers managed by IT.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing it equipment entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Asset
entityTypes.shortDescription: Any physical or digital resource owned by the organisation with trackable value.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing asset entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Software License
entityTypes.shortDescription: A license entitlement granting usage rights for a software product.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing software license entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Change Request
entityTypes.shortDescription: A formal request to alter a configuration, system, or product in a controlled manner.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing change request entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Work Order
entityTypes.shortDescription: An instruction to perform a specific task on the shop floor, including production, maintenance, or quality work.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing work order entities in the benchmark landscape.

entityTypes.title: Supplier
entityTypes.shortDescription: An external party providing goods or services, including qualification, risk, and compliance attributes.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing supplier entities. Distinct from Vendor (transactional) — Supplier covers strategic relationship, qualification, and compliance. Referenced across Procurement (sap.ariba), Manufacturing (sap.s4, my.mes), PLM (siemens.plm), and EHS (sap.ehs) domains.

entityTypes.title: Project
entityTypes.shortDescription: A time-bounded initiative with defined scope, budget, and deliverables.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing project entities. Cross-domain: covers capital projects (sap.s4), IT projects (corp.itsm), engineering projects (siemens.plm), HR workforce planning (sap.sf), and sustainability projects (sap.ehs).

entityTypes.title: Document
entityTypes.shortDescription: A structured or unstructured information artifact, including contracts, reports, certificates, and specifications.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing document entities. Cross-domain: covers compliance documents (sap.ehs), engineering specs (siemens.plm), HR policy documents (sap.sf, workday.hcm), procurement contracts (sap.ariba), and IT change documentation (corp.itsm).

entityTypes.title: Approval
entityTypes.shortDescription: A formal authorisation step in a business process, including workflow state, approver, and decision.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing approval entities. Cross-domain: used in procurement (sap.ariba purchase order approvals), HR (sap.sf leave and compensation approvals), ITSM (corp.itsm change approvals), finance (sap.s4 budget approvals), and manufacturing (my.mes quality release approvals).

entityTypes.title: Budget
entityTypes.shortDescription: A financial allocation for a cost centre, project, or department, including planned vs actual spend.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing budget entities. Cross-domain: covers cost centre budgets (sap.s4), procurement spend limits (sap.ariba), IT project budgets (corp.itsm), and HR headcount budgets (sap.sf, workday.hcm).

entityTypes.title: Task
entityTypes.shortDescription: An atomic unit of work assigned to a person or system within a process or project.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing task entities. Cross-domain: used in ITSM (corp.itsm service tasks), HR (sap.sf onboarding tasks), manufacturing (my.mes production tasks), CRM (sap.crm follow-up tasks), and marketing (emarsys.cx campaign tasks).

entityTypes.title: Location
entityTypes.shortDescription: A physical or logical place relevant to business operations, including plants, warehouses, offices, and sites.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing location entities. Cross-domain: covers production plants (my.mes, sap.s4), incident sites (sap.ehs), storage locations (sap.ariba), engineering sites (siemens.plm), and HR work locations (sap.sf, workday.hcm).

entityTypes.title: Notification
entityTypes.shortDescription: An alert or message triggered by a business event, including maintenance notifications, safety alerts, and campaign messages.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing notification entities. Cross-domain: used in manufacturing maintenance (my.mes, sap.s4 PM notifications), safety alerts (sap.ehs), ITSM alerts (corp.itsm), marketing messages (emarsys.cx), and HR notifications (sap.sf).

entityTypes.title: Compliance
entityTypes.shortDescription: A regulatory or policy requirement with associated controls, assessments, and evidence.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing compliance entities. Cross-domain: covers EHS regulatory compliance (sap.ehs), procurement compliance (sap.ariba), HR compliance (sap.sf, workday.hcm), IT security compliance (corp.itsm), and product compliance (siemens.plm).

entityTypes.title: Report
entityTypes.shortDescription: A structured output of analytical or operational data, including dashboards, KPI summaries, and regulatory filings.
entityTypes.description: Canonical business object representing report entities. Cross-domain: used across all systems — financial reports (sap.s4), safety reports (sap.ehs), procurement reports (sap.ariba), HR analytics (sap.sf, workday.hcm), manufacturing performance reports (my.mes), and marketing analytics (emarsys.cx).
